properties.rule: ixml.h: every routine that takes an IXML_Document requires one returned by a successful ixmlParseBuffer*, ixmlLoadDocument* or ixmlDocument_createDocument*. ixmlDocument_free frees the document and every node still in it; using the document afterwards is use-after-free until a new one is produced. The harness keeps one live document. The generated objects only borrow a document (Upnp<Class>_set_* of an IXML_Document field stores the pointer, the *_delete functions do not free it), and UpnpSendActionEx* sends it as the SOAP header; UpnpDownloadXmlDoc returns a new document.
properties.formula: (!doc_use W doc_ok) & G(doc_gone -> X(!doc_use W doc_ok))

doc_ok.meaning: a parse, load or create returned a usable document

doc_gone.meaning: the document is about to be freed

doc_use.meaning: a routine taking the live document is about to be called

examples.reason: every use sits between a successful parse and the free
a fresh document replaces the freed one
the parse failed, there is no document

properties.rule: ixml.h: ixmlNode_getFirstChild, ixmlNode_getLastChild, ixmlNode_getParentNode, ixmlNode_getNextSibling, ixmlNode_getPreviousSibling, ixmlNodeList_item, ixmlNamedNodeMap_item, ixmlNamedNodeMap_getNamedItem, ixmlElement_getAttributeNode*, ixmlDocument_getElementById return pointers owned by the tree. Restructuring the tree (append, insert, remove, replace) or removing/replacing an attribute may free or relink that node, and ixmlDocument_free frees all of it, so the pointer must be looked up again before further use. The document node itself is a stable handle: the structural routines may take it as parent and are modelled only as mutations.
properties.formula: (!node_use W node_ok) & G(tree_mutated -> X(!node_use W node_ok))

node_ok.meaning: a lookup returned a non-NULL node inside the tree

node_use.meaning: a routine taking the borrowed node is about to be called

tree_mutated.meaning: the tree is about to be restructured, an attribute replaced, or the document freed

examples.reason: removing the attribute may have freed the borrowed node
the document and every node in it are gone

properties.rule: ixml.h: ixmlDocument_create*, ixmlNode_cloneNode, ixmlDocument_importNode, ixmlNode_removeChild, ixmlNode_replaceChild and ixmlElement_removeAttributeNode return a node the caller owns; ixmlElement_setAttributeNode* and ixmlNode_replaceChild also hand back the replaced node. ixmlNode_appendChild, ixmlNode_insertBefore, ixmlElement_setAttributeNode* transfer ownership to the element/tree on success, and ixmlNode_free/ixmlAttr_free/ixmlElement_free/ixmlCDATASection_free consume a detached node. The harness keeps one detached node. replaceChild and setAttributeNode* both consume and return a node, so they only re-establish ownership.
properties.formula: (!loose_use W loose_owned) & G(loose_given -> X(!loose_use W loose_owned))

loose_owned.meaning: a create, clone, import, detach or replace returned a node the caller owns

loose_given.meaning: the parent or element accepted the detached node, or the node was freed

loose_use.meaning: a routine taking the detached node is about to be called

examples.reason: the attribute moved into the element and a new node was created before the next use
after the detached node is freed a new one is created before the next use
adding the same node twice after ownership moved

properties.rule: upnp.h:516 UpnpInit2 must be called before any other SDK function; upnp.h:612-631 UpnpFinish terminates the SDK (handles, servers, thread pools) and later calls return UPNP_E_FINISH.
